items.excerpt: Italian electronic producer Ciauru (Simone Privitera) won the Reply AI Music Contest, a competition celebrating creative uses of AI in music and performance; his winning project transformed video footage into visual-sonic experiences using AI platforms, framed as showcasing how AI can be used positively in the creative industries.

As fans, talent buyers and even record labels increasingly discover music via AI chatbots rather than plain name searches, musicians are urged to audit their online presence in private browser windows to see how search algorithms and AI tools actually perceive their digital footprint.

BBC music boss Lorna Clarke outlined the broadcaster's AI transparency commitments — including disclosing when AI is used in its output — though the piece questions whether the BBC can actually meet them without industry-wide disclosure standards.
